description: Returns the status of a feedback report this account sent earlier, by its server id: status new, triaged, shipped or declined, the team's response text if any, and updated_at, which moves only when the team acts on it. 404 if the id is not on this account. Cost: Free per call. Docs: https://docs.twitterapis.com/docs/reference/account/feedback-id

id.description: The server id of a sent report (a UUID), as returned when the report was sent. Not a local draft id.

name: twitter_feedback_get
